comment: Hand-written native-image metadata. Kept outside the <group>/<artifact> directory because
Spring AOT generates its own reachability-metadata.json there and overwrites it in target/classes.
Temporal wraps its service stubs in JDK proxies (WorkflowThreadMarker.protectFromWorkflowThread);
temporal-serviceclient only registers the WorkflowClient proxy.
shutdown/shutdownNow: Spring calls them reflectively as the inferred destroy method.
